headline: Indonesians Rely on Online Loans for Urgent Needs, Here's the Data
summary: Indonesian online lending grew 17.02% year on year, with 66.86% of loans used for consumption. The financial regulator OJK urged stronger risk management.
why: Online lending platforms in Indonesia are regulated by OJK, and their growth reflects household demand for credit outside traditional banks.
original_headline: Warga RI Andalkan Pinjaman Online Buat Kebutuhan Mendesak, Ini Datanya
